Cable-hauled automated people movers on: Izithuthi zabagibeli ezizenzakalelayo ezidonswa ngentambo emzileni ophakeme, ezidwetshwa ngethuluzi lezikhala eziqondile: eziya ziphindela ezinezitimela ezimbili, nezindingilizi ezicindezelwe ezinezitimela ezikhumulekayo ezima kuzo zonke iziteshi (ADR-0037 §7). Ezizihambisayo zidinga umhleli kajantshi futhi zizofika kamuva.
Cable-hauled shuttles and loops on a gui: Eziya ziphindela nezindingilizi ezidonswa ngentambo emzileni: chofoza iziteshi, izinsika ziyalandela.
